name: Poona Dal and Oil Industries Limited

risks: Earnings have declined by 0.2% per year over past 5 years
Does not have a meaningful market cap (₹371M)
Highly volatile share price over past 3 months

news.title: Full year 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹2.60 (vs ₹2.35 in FY 2025)
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹2.60 (up from ₹2.35 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹1.42b (down 3.2% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹14.8m (up 11% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 1.0% (up from 0.9% in FY 2025). The increase in margin was driven by lower expenses. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 16% per year but the company’s share price has only increased by 9% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings growth.

news.title: Poona Dal and Oil Industries Limited to Report Fiscal Year 2026 Results on May 19, 2026
news.body: Poona Dal and Oil Industries Limited announced that they will report fiscal year 2026 results on May 19, 2026

news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 7.5% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risks Earnings have declined by 1.3% per year over the past 5 years. Market cap is less than US$10m (₹371.6m market cap, or US$4.02m). Minor Risk Share price has been volatile over the past 3 months
